project_name.justification: The article refers to the project as the 'Kamuck Project' and 'Kamuck Property'. For example: 'Key Features of the Kamuck Property'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the press release: 'Solstice Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGC) (“Solstice”, “we”, “our” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has acquired a 31 km2 land position...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in the signature block: 'On Behalf of Solstice Gold Corp. Pablo McDonald, Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for a 100% interest in the project: '...to purchase the Option to acquire the Optionors’ 100% interest in the Kamuck Project.'

primary_commodity.justification: The article title clearly states the commodity of interest: 'Solstice Acquires New Lithium Project in the Emerging Quetico Lithium District, Ontario'.

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The buyer, Solstice Gold Corp., is listed on the TSXV (TSX Venture Exchange), which implies Canadian Dollars (CAD) for the '$' symbol used in the payment terms.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is $72,000, calculated by summing the required payments: '$10,000 in cash within ten days', 'a payment of $14,000 cash by the first anniversary', 'a payment of $20,000 cash by the second anniversary', and 'a payment of $28,000 cash by the third anniversary'.

share_payments_raw.justification: The text specifies the number of shares to be issued but does not provide an explicit total dollar value for the share payment.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the deal are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement includes the issuance of a specific number of shares: '...and issue 200,000 common shares and as soon as practicable after TSX Venture Exchange (“TSXV”) approval, to the Optionors.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any share warrant payments.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any option payments as consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention 200,000 shares but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.07'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not specify an exploration commitment in terms of meters drilled.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not specify a monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The sellers will retain a royalty as part of the deal: 'Upon exercise of the Option, the Optionors will retain a 1.5% net smelter return (the “NSR”) on the Kamuck Project.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The size of the acquired land position is stated in the first paragraph: '...acquired a 31 km2 land position...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is provided in the same phrase: '...acquired a 31 km2 land position...'

resource_size.justification: The text indicates no defined resource exists: 'There is no record of any exploration or detailed government mapping over the Kamuck area.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: 'Solstice Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGC)'.
